validationTool.reason: Unpatched validation layer retained old descriptor-heap reserved address map entries. Rebinding heaps then dereferenced freed command buffers in ValidateReservedRangeOverlap. Both CPU and GPU decode modes reproduced the crash. Upstream fix removes the old range before adding the new range; validation remains enabled.

decision.reason: Lower worker CPU preparation and staged bytes, but same-queue EXT decoding increases GPU frame P95. Keep opt-in.
decision.nextMeasurement: Split runtime copy/decode/barrier timestamps; assess small-batch CPU/GPU selection, batching and queue overlap before enabling by default.

limitations: Warm OS cache, not cold disk throughput.
Other desktop applications remained active. Background engine samples are retained per run; these observed ABBA differences are not an isolated-GPU performance guarantee.
Camera replay is identical, page sequences differ slightly due to timing-dependent feedback.
Stored bytes include CPU sideband and alignment; not measured PCIe bytes.
Decode timing includes worker page preparation; legacy Drawable latency ends at CPU residency completion, not actual first draw.
DLSS first-frame setup contaminates wall time and initial demand latency; steady frame distributions exclude 300 warmup frames.
Stream Begin includes copies/decompression/barriers; it is not an isolated GPU decode timestamp.
Quality checks sample 15 checkpoints, not every pixel of every frame.
Streamline teardown stalls after flushed successful reports and terminal test teardown; the replay script reclaims only its own process after eight seconds.
Validation support for new extensions may be incomplete; byte oracles and safe-cut checks supplement validation logs.
